correctedState: Confirmed with three corrections. LINE NUMBERS: `--mode` is apps/cli/src/index.ts:104; the unknown-arg `default:` arm is :160-165; `permissionMode: (...) || 'bypassPermissions'` is :842; the help block :2043-2056 is correct. CONSEQUENCE (the real error): unrecognized flags are NOT 'ignored'. For `run`, `rest` IS the prompt — cmdRun does `readPrompt(args.rest, args.rest)` (index.ts:766) — so `nessy-general-agent run "Fix the lint" --permission-mode acceptEdits --allowedTools Bash,Read` builds the literal prompt `Fix the lint --permission-mode acceptEdits --allowedTools Bash,Read` and sends it to the model, then runs at bypassPermissions. Verified by executing parseArgs: rest = ["Fix the lint","--permission-mode","acceptEdits","--allowedTools","Bash,Read"]. Worse than silent, not milder: the CI operator's intended lockdown becomes prompt text. PER-FLAG: two of the thirteen have a working equivalent and only lack the flag name — `--include-partial-messages` is unconditional here (sendAndStream writes every session:event, text deltas included, whenever --output-format stream-json is set), and `--continue`/`--resume` exist as `run --no-cleanup` then `send <session-id>` (with `sessions` to list), documented in docs/cli.md. The remaining eleven — `--permission-mode` (spelled `--mode`), `--allowedTools`, `--append-system-prompt`, `--append-system-prompt-file`, `--system-prompt`, `--settings`, `--mcp-config`, `--agents`, `--plugin-dir`, `--plugin-url`, `--forward-subagent-text` — have no per-invocation equivalent; configuration lives in the config dir and the workspace, with only `--source <slug>` covering part of the source/MCP enabling axis.
